articles.title: Defense Secretary Hegseth: Ceasefire Not Over Despite Gulf Exchanges
articles.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth stated the ceasefire with Iran remains intact despite US-Iran exchanges of fire over Strait of Hormuz control, noting CENTCOM communicated with hundreds of ships and companies.

articles.title: Project Freedom Launch: US Escorts Stranded Ships Through Hormuz
articles.description: CENTCOM launched Operation Project Freedom on May 4, deploying guided-missile destroyers and 100+ aircraft with 15,000 service members to escort commercial vessels through the blocked Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: CENTCOM Denies Iranian Missile Strike on US Navy Ship
articles.description: CENTCOM confirmed no US Navy ships were struck and reiterated that US forces are supporting Project Freedom while enforcing the naval blockade on Iranian ports.

articles.title: US Helicopters Destroy Six Iranian Boats in Strait of Hormuz
articles.description: CENTCOM reported that US helicopters destroyed six Iranian small boats attacking ships in the Strait of Hormuz on May 4-5.

articles.title: Trump Claims Iran Military Reduced to Firing 'Peashooters'
articles.description: President Trump stated Iran's military capability has been severely degraded and claimed Tehran wants to make a deal despite public rhetoric.

articles.title: Iranian Military Warns US to Keep Out of Hormuz
articles.description: On May 4, Iranian military issued warning to US forces to stay out of the Strait of Hormuz as Project Freedom commenced.

articles.title: IRGC Navy Claims Missile Strike on US Naval Frigate
articles.description: IRGC-aligned news agency claimed Iranian navy fired two missiles hitting an American naval frigate in Strait of Hormuz, though CENTCOM denied the strike.

articles.title: Iran Responds to Project Freedom with Military Action Near Jask
articles.description: Iranian state media reported IRGCN missile attack on US Navy warship near Jask on May 4 after vessel ignored Revolutionary Guard warnings to halt.

articles.title: Iran Denies Responsibility for UAE Drone Strike on Oil Plant
articles.description: Iran stated it had no pre-planned programme to attack UAE and characterized the drone strike on Fujairah oil processing plant as product of US military adventurism.

articles.title: Houthi Movement Warns Against Escalation in Hormuz Campaign
articles.description: Houthi movement warned it would respond to escalation against Iran, specifically cautioning Bahrain and UAE they would be first to lose in battle.
